Absorb Bulb: After surviving a Water hit, raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Used up.
Adamant Orb: Dialga's Dragon and Steel moves do 1.2× damage.
Adrenaline Orb: When Intimidate affects the holder, raises Speed by 1 stage. Used up, even if Intimidate's Attack drop is blocked.
Air Balloon: Makes the holder airborne, avoiding Ground moves and grounded entry hazards. A damaging hit pops it; indirect damage does not.
Assault Vest: Sp. Def ×1.5, but the holder cannot select status moves.
Berry Juice: At 1/2 max HP or less, restores 20 HP. Used up.
Big Root: Restores 1.3× HP from draining moves, Leech Seed, Ingrain and Aqua Ring. Does not increase damage dealt or Leftovers healing.

Binding Band.gen<=5: Trapping moves such as Bind deal 1/8 of the target's max HP each turn instead of 1/16. Does not increase the initial hit's damage.
Binding Band: Trapping moves such as Bind deal 1/6 of the target's max HP each turn instead of 1/8. Does not increase the initial hit's damage.

Black Sludge: At each turn's end, restores 1/16 max HP to a Poison-type holder; other types lose 1/8 max HP instead.
Blue Orb: Kyogre becomes Primal Kyogre on entering battle, gaining Primordial Sea and its heavy rain. Cannot be removed from Kyogre.
Blunder Policy: After a move misses because of accuracy or evasion, raises Speed by 2 stages. Used up; immunities and Protect do not trigger it.
Booster Energy: Activates Protosynthesis or Quark Drive: the highest stat is ×1.3, or ×1.5 if Speed. Used up; the boost ends on switching out.
Bright Powder: Moves targeting the holder have 0.9× accuracy.
Burn Drive: Makes Genesect's Techno Blast Fire type.
Cell Battery: After surviving an Electric hit, raises Attack by 1 stage. Used up; an Electric immunity prevents activation.
Charcoal: The holder's Fire moves have 1.2× power. Not used up.
Chill Drive: Makes Genesect's Techno Blast Ice type.
Choice Band: Attack ×1.5, but locks the holder into its first move until it switches out or loses the item.
Choice Scarf: Speed ×1.5, but locks the holder into its first move until it switches out or loses the item.
Choice Specs: Sp. Atk ×1.5, but locks the holder into its first move until it switches out or loses the item.
Clear Amulet: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering the holder's stat stages. Does not stop the holder's own stat drops.
Covert Cloak: Blocks extra effects of damaging moves, such as Fake Out's flinch and Scald's burn. Does not block status moves or the damage itself.
Damp Rock: Rain started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.

Dark Gem.gen<=5: The holder's first successful damaging Dark move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up. Boosts every hit of a multi-hit move.
Dark Gem: The holder's first Dark move does 1.3× damage; the gem is used up.

Destiny Knot: If another Pokémon infatuates the holder, that Pokémon also becomes infatuated.
Douse Drive: Makes Genesect's Techno Blast Water type.

Dream Ball.gen<=7: In Gen 5's Entree Forest, always catches the Pokémon. Outside that encounter, catch rate ×1; sleep gives no extra Dream Ball bonus.
Dream Ball: Catch rate ×4 on a sleeping Pokémon, ×1 otherwise.

Eject Button: After surviving a damaging move, switches the holder to a teammate you choose. Used up; waits until all hits finish and cancels the attacker's U-turn or Volt Switch switch.
Eject Pack: When a stat stage falls, switches the holder to a teammate you choose. Used up; can trigger from Intimidate or the holder's own move.
Electric Seed: In Electric Terrain, raises Defense by 1 stage, even if airborne. Used up; the boost remains after the terrain ends.
Enigma Berry: After surviving a super-effective hit, restores 1/4 max HP. Eaten once.
Eviolite: Defense and Sp. Def ×1.5 if the holder can still evolve.
Expert Belt: Super-effective moves do 1.2× damage. No boost to neutral or resisted hits.
Flame Orb: Burns the holder at each turn's end if it has no status and can be burned. Activates Guts; not used up.
Float Stone: Halves the holder's weight, affecting weight-based moves such as Low Kick and Heavy Slam.
Focus Band: Each would-be knockout from an attack has a 10% chance to leave the holder at 1 HP. Can work below full HP; not used up.
Focus Sash: At full HP, survives one would-be knockout from an attack at 1 HP. Used up; later hits of a multi-hit move can still KO it.
Full Incense: The holder moves last within its priority bracket, even under Trick Room.

Grass Gem.gen<=5: The holder's first successful damaging Grass move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up. Boosts every hit of a multi-hit move.
Grass Gem: The holder's first Grass move does 1.3× damage; the gem is used up.

Grassy Seed: In Grassy Terrain, raises Defense by 1 stage, even if airborne. Used up; the boost remains after the terrain ends.

Grip Claw.gen<=4: Trapping moves such as Bind always last 5 turns.
Grip Claw: Trapping moves such as Bind always last 7 turns.

Griseous Orb: Giratina takes its Origin Forme; its Dragon and Ghost moves do 1.2× damage.
Heat Rock: Sun started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Heavy-Duty Boots: Prevents entry hazards from affecting the holder when it switches in.
Icy Rock: Hail or snow started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Iron Ball: Halves Speed and grounds the holder, removing airborne immunity to Ground moves and grounded entry hazards.
Jaboca Berry: After a physical hit, the attacker loses 1/8 of its own max HP. Eaten once; does not require contact.
Kee Berry: After surviving a physical hit, raises Defense by 1 stage. Eaten once.

King's Rock.gen<=4: Eligible damaging moves gain a 10% flinch chance per hit. Only stops a target that has not acted; some moves are ineligible, even without a built-in flinch chance.
King's Rock: Damaging moves without a built-in flinch chance gain a 10% flinch chance per hit. Only stops a target that has not acted.

Lagging Tail: The holder moves last within its priority bracket, even under Trick Room.
Lansat Berry: At 1/4 max HP or less, raises critical-hit rate by 2 stages. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Lax Incense: Moves targeting the holder have 0.9× accuracy.
Leek: Raises Farfetch'd's or Sirfetch'd's critical-hit rate by 2 stages.
Leftovers: Restores 1/16 of the holder's max HP at the end of every turn.
Leppa Berry: When a move reaches 0 PP, restores 10 PP to it. Eaten once.
Life Orb: Damaging moves do 1.3× damage. The holder then loses 1/10 of its max HP (not with Magic Guard, or on a move Sheer Force boosted).

Light Ball.gen<=4: Doubles the power of Pikachu's damaging moves.
Light Ball: Doubles Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk.

Light Clay: Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil set by the holder last 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten them.
Loaded Dice: Moves that normally hit 2-5 times hit 4 or 5 times, 50% each. Triple Axel and Triple Kick need only one accuracy check; Population Bomb hits 4-10 times.
Lucky Punch: Raises Chansey's critical-hit rate by 2 stages.
Lum Berry: Cures the holder's major status condition and confusion. Eaten once.
Luminous Moss: After surviving a Water hit, raises Sp. Def by 1 stage. Used up.
Lustrous Orb: Palkia's Dragon and Water moves do 1.2× damage.
Macho Brace: Halves the holder's Speed in battle.
Maranga Berry: After surviving a special hit, raises Sp. Def by 1 stage. Eaten once.

Mental Herb: Cures infatuation, Taunt, Encore, Disable, Torment and Heal Block. Used up.

Metal Powder: Doubles Ditto's Defense, but stops working after Transform.

Metronome.gen<=4: Repeating the same move raises damage by 10% per repeat, up to 2× on the 11th use. Changing moves, switching out or a failed previous use resets it.
Metronome: Repeating the same move raises damage by 20% per repeat, up to 2× on the 6th use. Changing moves, switching out or a failed previous use resets it.

Micle Berry: At 1/4 max HP or less, gives the next move 1.2× accuracy. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Misty Seed: In Misty Terrain, raises Sp. Def by 1 stage, even if airborne. Used up; the boost remains after the terrain ends.
Normalium Z: Once per battle for the team, turns a Normal attack into Breakneck Blitz: power 100/120/140/160/175/180/185/190/195/200 for original power up to 55/65/75/85/95/100/110/125/130/above 130, except move-specific overrides. A Normal status move gets its own Z bonus instead. Not used up; cannot be knocked off, stolen or swapped.
Occa Berry: Halves the damage of one super-effective Fire hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Oran Berry: At 1/2 max HP or less, restores 10 HP. Eaten once.
Power Herb: Skips the charging turn of a two-turn move, including Geomancy. Used up; does not skip Solar Beam's bad-weather damage penalty.
Protective Pads: Prevents contact-triggered effects against the holder, such as Rocky Helmet damage, Static and King's Shield's Attack drop.
Psychic Seed: In Psychic Terrain, raises Sp. Def by 1 stage, even if airborne. Used up; the boost remains after the terrain ends.
Punching Glove: Punching moves do 1.1× damage and no longer make contact, avoiding effects such as Rocky Helmet and Static.

Quick Ball.gen<=4: Catch rate ×4 on the first turn of a wild battle, ×1 afterward.
Quick Ball: Catch rate ×5 on the first turn of a wild battle, ×1 afterward.

Quick Claw: Each turn, has a 20% chance to move first within its priority bracket, regardless of Speed or Trick Room. Does not outrun a higher-priority move.
Quick Powder: Doubles Ditto's Speed, but stops working after Transform.
Razor Claw: Raises the holder's critical-hit rate by 1 stage.

Razor Fang.gen<=4: Eligible damaging moves gain a 10% flinch chance per hit. Only stops a target that has not acted; some moves are ineligible, even without a built-in flinch chance.
Razor Fang: Damaging moves without a built-in flinch chance gain a 10% flinch chance per hit. Only stops a target that has not acted.

Red Card: After surviving a damaging move, forces the attacker into a random teammate. Used up; waits until all hits finish and can stop U-turn or Volt Switch choosing its switch.
Red Orb: Groudon becomes Primal Groudon on entering battle, gaining Desolate Land and its harsh sun. Cannot be removed from Groudon.
Ring Target: Removes the holder's type-based immunities, letting Normal hit Ghost or Ground hit Flying. Does not remove ability immunities such as Levitate.
Rocky Helmet: Each contact hit costs the attacker 1/6 of its own max HP. Triggers on every hit of a multi-hit move; Magic Guard prevents the damage.
Room Service: When Trick Room is active, lowers the holder's Speed by 1 stage. Used up.
Rowap Berry: After a special hit, the attacker loses 1/8 of its own max HP. Eaten once; does not require contact.
Rusted Shield: Zamazenta becomes Crowned Shield, gaining Steel typing and turning Iron Head into Behemoth Bash.
Rusted Sword: Zacian becomes Crowned Sword, gaining Steel typing and turning Iron Head into Behemoth Blade.
Safety Goggles: Blocks powder moves, Effect Spore and weather damage from sandstorm and hail.
Salac Berry: At 1/4 max HP or less, raises Speed by 1 stage. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Scope Lens: Raises the holder's critical-hit rate by 1 stage.
Shed Shell: Lets the holder switch out despite trapping moves or abilities. Does not let it flee from wild battles.
Shell Bell: After a damaging move, restores 1/8 of the total damage dealt, including all hits and targets. Does not trigger on a Sheer Force-boosted move.
Shock Drive: Makes Genesect's Techno Blast Electric type.
Sitrus Berry: Eaten when the holder drops to 1/2 HP or less: restores 1/4 of its max HP. Once.
Smoke Ball: Lets the holder flee from wild battles, even through trapping. Does not let it switch out of trapping.
Smooth Rock: Sandstorm started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Snowball: After surviving an Ice hit, raises Attack by 1 stage. Used up.

Soul Dew.gen<=6: Latias's and Latios's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def are ×1.5.
Soul Dew: Latias's and Latios's Dragon and Psychic moves do 1.2× damage.

Stick: Raises Farfetch'd's critical-hit rate by 2 stages.
Sticky Barb: At each turn's end, the holder loses 1/8 max HP. Transfers to an attacker with no held item when it lands a contact move.
Terrain Extender: Terrain started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Thick Club: Doubles Cubone's and Marowak's Attack, including Alolan Marowak.
Throat Spray: After the holder successfully uses a sound move, raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Used up; works with sound-based status moves too.
Toxic Orb: Badly poisons the holder at each turn's end if it has no status and can be poisoned. Poison Heal restores 1/8 max HP each turn instead of poison damage. Not used up.
Weakness Policy: After surviving a super-effective hit, raises Attack and Sp. Atk by 2 stages each. Used up; can activate between hits of a multi-hit move.
White Herb: Restores all negative stat stages to 0, then is used up. Keeps positive stages; clears both Defense drops from Shell Smash at once.
Zoom Lens: The holder's moves have 1.2× accuracy when the target has already acted this turn.
